In [[geometry]], the '''bigyrate diminished rhombicosidodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|79}}}}). It can be constructed as a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two [[pentagonal cupola]]e rotated through 36 [[Degree (angle)|degree]]s, and a third pentagonal cupola removed. (None of the cupolae can be adjacent.)
